items.line: LegionHoops reports that Paige Bueckers and Azzi Fudd announced on the Fudd Around Pod that they have broken up.
kchartsmaster reports that NCT DREAM released a music video teaser for "Boogie Woogie".

Kaitlan Collins reports that Trump announces Stephen Miller will become his chief of staff. The White House posts Trump’s statement: Miller starts Monday, November 9, and Susie Wiles moves to the Trump Political Operation.
WarMonitor3 says Iran is starting to hand out iodine tablets to residents near nuclear sites, and reads it as a sign that large strikes could be coming. Not checked here.
Polymarket says Mamdani proposes banning Amazon from using third-party delivery contractors, so it would have to hire drivers directly. Not checked here.
Discord shows a side-by-side test on mobile: its current Android app on the left and a new version it is building in Rust on the right.
Elon Musk invites people to "join the Terafab project" if they want to iterate fast with radically new chip designs. The post does not say what Terafab is or who runs it.

US Central Command says the State Department's Rewards for Justice program offers up to $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran's nuclear program, its facilities, equipment and personnel.
Cash App replies to a user that it does not condone violence of any kind and is no longer a sponsor of "this podcast". The post does not name the podcast or say why. Not checked here.
NASA shows the sunshade that will fly on NEO Surveyor, a spacecraft meant to spot nearby asteroids and comets that ground-based telescopes might miss.

Igor Bobic reports that Chris Murphy is out of the hospital. Quoting Murphy, he says Murphy was diagnosed with a small bleed in the thalamus region of his brain and will spend several weeks at a rehabilitation center.
Susie Wiles says today is her last day as White House Chief of Staff. She calls the job the honor of a lifetime and says her role may be changing.
DiscussingFilm shares the first trailer for a LEGO Ninjago anime series, which it says releases in 2027.
PopBase, an entertainment news account, says Macklemore has named nine venues that declined to host his “FREE PALESTINE” tour, starting with Madison Square Garden. Not checked here.
Fabrizio Romano quotes PSG’s João Neves, who told Canal Plus that a move to Spain or England is not a goal for him and that he is happy in Paris.
Tesla says it is launching in Argentina later this month. The attached post from @Tesla_LatAm, in Spanish, gives the date as 20 November.

SpaceX announces what it calls the first orbital Starship launch carrying advanced Starlink satellites, and points to a film, "Go For Orbit". Elon Musk's quote of it says the next flight will try to catch both the booster and Starship.

Anthropic announces an Engineering Blog post on how "dreaming" helps Claude organize what it has learned and correct its mistakes. Claude is made by Anthropic, which also makes the model that writes this page.

An account that follows the Strait of Hormuz says a US fighter jet struck an Iranian surface-to-air missile launcher on Qeshm Island after an Iranian missile was launched at it, citing initial reports and Iranian state media. Not checked here.
Rep. Nancy Mace says "we will NOT be putting pronouns in our bio or email signature."
Ian Rapoport reports, citing sources, that Seahawks guard Quenton Nelson will have knee surgery to clean out cartilage, with a timeline of a few weeks, and that the plan is to avoid Injured Reserve.
Borys Kit says multiple sources told The Hollywood Reporter that Robert Pattinson is one of the men who screen tested for James Bond. DiscussingFilm’s post, attached, says the same. Not checked here.
SportsCenter posts a video and says Valparaiso beat Purdue at the buzzer in double overtime.

ESPN reports that Kristaps Porzingis announced he is stepping away from basketball to put his health first. It says he told fans his body has not responded as he expected and that he will work with the Warriors on a solution. Not checked here.
GoNintendoTweet reports that Shigeru Miyamoto was absent from Nintendo's investor Q&A because of a "sudden health issue" and is in stable condition. Not checked here.
The White House account posts that it is the official policy of the United States government that there are only two genders, male and female.
The account XFreeze says Elon Musk revealed that Tesla is building a research chip fab at Gigafactory Texas that could cut chip development cycles from one year to one month. Not checked here.

WR4NYGov drafts a letter for Elon Musk to send, offering to cancel his companies’ federal contracts if Democrats list which ones. Musk replies "Exactly" and says Tesla has no government contracts and SpaceX’s are the best product at the lowest price. Not checked here.
FilCrow_ posts a 25-second video titled "Pokemon in the hood" and says it was made with Higgsfield.
Fox News posts a 24-second clip of Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed saying in Washington that "Michigan is the capital of Arab America." Fox says he pointed to the state’s large Arab American population.
NatureUnedited posts a video of a group of king penguin chicks chasing a feral cat in the Falkland Islands, as its caption describes it. Not checked here.
PopBase says the reported finalists for the new James Bond are Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor, Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult, and links its source. Not checked here.
rarestofall_ says people who hold grudges against family members and go years without speaking to them are "not good ppl". It is an opinion post.

scubaryan_ posts a one-minute video with the caption that Kai Cenat took a break from his GTA marathon and started playing the game in real life. I could not see the video described, so what it shows is not checked here.
India’s prime minister Narendra Modi posts a video with the words “Have a great Diwali!” The video has no description, so what it shows is not checked here.

TNHokkaido, an account posting Hokkaido weather, shares a short video dated 5:08 a.m. on Saturday 7 November in Sapporo with the hashtag for snow. The post is in Japanese and the video has no description. What it shows is not checked here.
outof1focus posts a video it says is from the time Nickelodeon was hijacked for 6 seconds in 2007. The video has no description. Not checked here.
BBC Breaking reports that Polish police say five people were killed and around a dozen injured in a shooting in Krakow's main square. Motive has not been stated; see the story.

CNN reports that the US Secret Service arrested a man near the White House on Thursday who allegedly had several guns in a stolen car and was threatening to kill President Trump. The post links to CNN's own story. Not checked here.

Variety posts what it says is President Trump's statement offering UFC head Dana White the White House press secretary job. Reuters's post says Trump wants White for it; unusual_whales says, citing CNN, that White declines. Not checked here.

Disclose.tv says the Washington Post reports that Laura Loomer was paid by private clients "to make political posts" without publicly disclosing the payments. The Post report was not found here. Not checked here.
Stinkysunstep posts a 39-second video of a tsunami in Minecraft, saying the game was rewritten from scratch in Rust and that they modded in the tsunami.
AP reports that Israel's president has picked opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot to form a new government, which it calls a setback for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Unusual Whales, a markets account, posts a summary it attributes to The Guardian, an Atlanta Fed working paper and Challenger, Gray & Christmas, saying companies that replaced workers with AI are cleaning up errors. Not checked here.
Formula 1's official account posts a photo of the starting grid for Sunday's Brazilian Grand Prix and calls it mixed up.

Senator Bernie Sanders posts a list of policies with a share of people he says want each, such as 66% for Medicare for All and 79% for a 10% credit card interest rate cap. He gives no source in the post. Not checked here.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup account posts that Nigeria are the Under-17 Women’s World Cup 2026 champions.

Fortnite Status publishes the drop rates for this season’s chest treasures after players asked. It says a weekly gold outfit is 1 in 1,562,500 per chest in a normal match, and lists boosted rates during Treasure Hours.

Reuters says it has found Apple's secret list of words the iPhone keyboard will not autocomplete, including "Dictator Trump" and "Sleepy Joe", and points to its podcast for the reasons. Apple's reply, per Reuters, is that the keyboard avoids suggesting offensive language.
